lines.text: The LORD raised up Hadad the Edomite against Solomon, and Hadad fled to Egypt as a boy.
God raised up Rezon son of Eliada, who settled in Hebron and ruled Aram with hostility toward Israel.
Jeroboam son of Nebat, a servant of Solomon, rebelled, and Solomon put him over the labor force of Joseph's house.
The prophet Ahijah tore a new cloak into twelve pieces and told Jeroboam to take ten.
Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, so Jeroboam fled to Egypt, to Pharaoh Neco, and stayed until Solomon died.
